name: Document Product Positioning
summary: Create a reusable positioning record with evidence, decisions, boundaries, and unresolved questions.
description: Create or update a project-local product positioning record covering audience, situation, alternatives, differentiated value, proof, language, constraints, and open questions. Use before substantial marketing work when foundational context is missing or inconsistent.
risk_reason: This skill creates a reusable positioning record with evidence, decisions, boundaries, and unresolved questions; it does not turn uncertain assumptions into universal brand claims.
refuses: It does not invent an ICP, differentiation, product capability, proof, or customer language.
It does not overwrite an approved positioning record or expose confidential research without permission.
It does not turn uncertain assumptions into universal brand claims.

operational.latency_reason: The skill creates a reusable positioning record with evidence, decisions, boundaries, and unresolved questions, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
